title: Blameless post-incident review template and cadence
summary: Programmatic incident-response control that mandates a structured, blameless review record for every closed incident: timeline, decisions taken under partial evidence, contributing factors, and learnings. The control's evidence shape is the review artifact emitted by the post-incident-review playbook's blameless-review-template step; the control is satisfied when a non-empty artifact exists for every incident closed within the window.

component.title: Blameless post-incident review programme
component.description: Operator-owned programme that schedules and captures a blameless post-incident review for every closed incident, with the review record attached to the case before final closure.

control-implementations.description: Implements the lessons-learned and post-incident analysis requirements of the incident-response control family.

implemented-requirements.description: Incident handling: post-incident analysis is performed and the results are incorporated into incident-response procedures, training, and testing.
Incident response plan: the plan addresses the post-incident review process and is updated to reflect lessons learned.

sources: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 — IR-4 Incident Handling, IR-8 Incident Response Plan
ENISA — Good Practices for Supply Chain Cybersecurity (post-incident learning patterns)
